facts.business: Industrial Investment Trust Limited is a Non-Deposit taking Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC-ICC) classified as a Base Layer NBFC, primarily operating as a holding company with investments in equity shares, mutual funds, fixed deposits, treasury bills, and corporate loans.

auditor.name: Maharaj N R Suresh and Co., LLP
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on investment in subsidiary IITL Projects Limited (Rs 1361.23 lakhs) where net worth is fully eroded and financial statements prepared on non-going concern basis; Key Audit Matters on investments in mutual funds/equity shares (Rs 23078.57 lakhs), contingent liabilities for income tax (Rs 840.01 lakhs), and loans advanced (Rs 14657.61 lakhs)

Contingent liabilities on account of income tax aggregating to Rs 840.01 lakhs
Concentration of investments in mutual funds and equity shares (Rs 23078.57 lakhs)
Loan book of Rs 14657.61 lakhs advanced to various parties
